description: Rollup and Vite plugin that fetches bare package imports and URL imports from esm.sh, jsDelivr or Skypack at build time and bundles them like local code, with tree-shaking, version pinning, Subresource Integrity checks and an on-disk fetch cache.
rules: The default priority is ["esm.sh"]. Before 0.5.0 it was ["skypack"]; set priority: ["skypack"] to keep the old order.
importCdn() is a Rollup 3 and 4 plugin and a Vite 8 plugin, for both vite build and vite dev; add it to plugins without a cast.
Under Vite a bare name installed in node_modules is used from there; only names Vite cannot resolve are fetched from the CDN.
Pin packages with versions, such as versions: { react: "18.2.0" }, for reproducible builds. A package pin also applies to its subpaths.
cache stores only URLs pinned to an exact major.minor.patch version. Unpinned imports are fetched again on every build.
integrity maps an absolute URL to an SRI hash such as sha384-<base64 digest>. It is not checked under vite dev, where the browser loads URL imports from the CDN.
With "jsdelivr" in priority, pin every package you import through it, or the bundle can hold two copies of a package.
A custom priority function receives the specifier and its pinned version and returns an absolute URL, or undefined to try the next entry.
